propositions: The test's monkeypatched observed_upsert closure has a narrow signature that does not accept evidence_sufficient and seeded kwargs that the real CriterionBank.upsert now expects, causing TypeError when production calls hit the bounded-fallback path on the bedrock arm.
The test stub must forward all keyword arguments to the real upsert via **kwargs (preserving evidence_sufficient and seeded signal) while capturing source for bookkeeping observation.
A shared test helper tests/_bank_observer.py::make_observed_upsert should extract the bank-observation pattern for reuse across live and unit tests without live credentials.

Unit regression test tests/unit/test_completion_bank_observer_forwarding.py must verify the stub correctly forwards evidence_sufficient and seeded through the wrapper, failing RED with the exact TypeError before the fix and passing GREEN after.
